"but all of these are cool in the context of RWAs. crypto is just the back end, SOVs are really struggling with a lack of identity."

disagree heavily, social trading works because there is some intangible value assigned to traders that have a good track record & ppl trust their opinions, tokenization of that value is very unique to crypto

also memecoins are the primary assets w/ this social trading realm atm, & they derive all of their value from how much attention they are able to generate, they aren't RWAs at all

24/7 perps on stocks, prediction markets, and social trading are all sides of the same coin, crypto is very good at enabling speculation but also providing social proof for talented speculators

if you believe entertainment finance & the creator economy is going to 100x from here then crypto is by far the most exciting bet to make in that space & it isn't particularly close, there are very limited liquid assets that you can buy to get exposure to this atm

believe that the current moves by @RobinhoodCrypto & @X confirm this thesis even more, @RobinhoodApp sees the value of 24/7 access to *all* markets on-chain including RWAs is why they are devoting so much time to building their L2 with Arbitrum, & @X is investing heavily in the creator economy vertical with their focus on @XCreators & @XMoney + highlighting tickers in app through search and adding in subscription tiers for privileged access to creators with quality information to give out on markets

i am actually most excited for crypto than i have been in a long time because i believe this is a thesis that institutional capital can easily understand and also a thesis that aligns heavily with the younger generation

crypto as an industry will benefit from the intersection of social and finance more than anything else
